name: ViewTicketInbox
title: Blocks/View/ViewTicketInbox
summary: The support agent's ticket inbox: a `PageHeader` with Create Ticket over one controls band (a `Select` of saved views with their counts, such as My open tickets (4), Unassigned (3) and Overdue (2, needs action); a `PropertyFilter` over status, priority, assignee, group, channel and tag, with free text over subject, requester and number; Refresh and `CollectionPreferences`) and a `DataTable` of the view's tickets on `useCollection`, most urgent SLA first: a selection checkbox, Subject as a `TableCellLink` with an unread mark, the requester `Avatar`, name and number under it, Status as `TableCellStatus`, `PriorityTag`, the assignee `Avatar` with presence, the next SLA as a `Countdown` (paused while Pending or On hold) and Updated as `TableCellTime`; Group and Channel are hidden columns. Selecting tickets opens a bulk bar in the controls band: the count, Select all N tickets, Clear selection, Assign and Change status as menus (`DropdownMenuRoot`), Merge (two or more; a `ConfirmDialog` asks which ticket to keep) and Close (confirmed with the count), each label counting the selection. A row click or Enter opens the ticket. A view with no tickets says You're all caught up and offers all open tickets, filters that match nothing offer Clear filters, and a failed load is a danger `Alert` with Retry. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: My open tickets holds no ticket: the heading and controls stay, and a flush EmptyState says You're all caught up, with Show all open tickets.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the filter and preferences are disabled, Refresh spins and the table shows its skeleton rows.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The tickets could not load: the disabled controls stay and a danger Alert with Retry takes the table's place.

variants.name: Filtered
variants.summary: A Channel = Phone filter on My open tickets hides every ticket: the table shows No matching tickets with Clear filters.

variants.name: Selected
variants.summary: Three tickets selected: the bulk bar in the controls band counts them and offers Assign (3), Change status (3), Merge (3) and Close (3).
